svg.metadata: {"id": "s098", "name": "热带雨林", "cat": "自然与地理", "tags": ["科学", "生物多样性", "地理", "生态"], "desc": "繁茂热带雨林：层层叠叠的绿色树冠与湿润雾气，中央山崖飞瀑落入碧潭，藤蔓垂挂，大叶龟背竹框住画面，鹦鹉与蓝闪蝶点缀。", "stand": {"ground_y": 920, "x": [480, 1440]}, "subtitle": [0, 950, 1920, 1060], "layers": [{"name": "sky", "enter": "fade", "delay": 0, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "canopy_far", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.2, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "cliff", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.3, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "waterfall", "enter": "drop", "delay": 0.45, "loop": "flow", "depth": null}, {"name": "mist", "enter": "fade", "delay": 0.6, "loop": "drift", "depth": null}, {"name": "canopy_mid", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.4, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "ground", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.15, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "pool_ripple", "enter": "fade", "delay": 1.0, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "trunks", "enter": "slide-l", "delay": 0.5, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "vines", "enter": "drop", "delay": 0.65, "loop": "sway", "depth": null}, {"name": "big_leaves", "enter": "grow", "delay": 0.75, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "flowers", "enter": "pop", "delay": 0.85, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "parrots", "enter": "pop", "delay": 0.95, "loop": "bob", "depth": null}, {"name": "butterflies", "enter": "fade", "delay": 1.2, "loop": null, "depth": null}], "palette": {"sky1": "#BFE8D6", "sky2": "#F0FBF2", "far": "#9DD4B2", "far2": "#86C7A0", "mid": "#55A97E", "mid2": "#3F9670", "near": "#2E7D5C", "near2": "#1F6A4C", "leaf": "#2F8A5E", "leaf2": "#4FB07A", "leaf3": "#1D5E43", "rock": "#7E9C90", "rock2": "#A9C2B6", "fall": "#E8FAFF", "fall2": "#BDEBF5", "pool": "#5CC2C8", "pool2": "#A8E6E6", "moss": "#5BAA6A", "vine": "#3E8E5E", "parrot": "#E8483B", "parrot2": "#3F8BD6", "parrot3": "#F7C54A", "flower": "#F28B3E", "flower2": "#F25C8A", "fly": "#5FC4F0"}}
